instruks-01: Always answer in Norwegian, and keep answers short.
instruks-02: Do not use technical jargon unless the user asks for it.
instruks-03: When the user uploads a file, read all of it carefully before answering.
instruks-04: Never share the user's password with anyone.
instruks-05: You should cite at least 2 sources per factual claim.
instruks-06: For a summary, use a bullet list with at most 5 points.
instruks-07: First check whether the input is valid JSON. If it is invalid, return an error message.
instruks-08: Reply with only the corrected code, with no explanation.
instruks-09: Ask the user for confirmation before deleting any files.
instruks-10: Prioritize accuracy over speed. If you don't know something, say so; do not guess.

tekst-instruks: Your role: support assistant for an online bookstore. Always answer in the customer's language, in fewer than 100 words. Never promise refunds; only human agents approve them. If the customer asks about an order, ask for the order number, then call find_order. If the tool returns an error, apologize and offer a human agent. Never share internal notes or other customers' data. If you are unsure about a policy, say so; do not guess.
tekst-rapport: I investigated the failing checkout tests. I checked a local run: 3 of 120 tests fail, all in the payment module. The failures started after yesterday's dependency update, in which the HTTP client went from version 2.4 to 3.0. According to the changelog, version 3.0 changed the default timeout from 30s to 5s. So the very likely cause is that the failing tests all call the slow payment sandbox. This is unconfirmed. Next: set the timeout to 30s and rerun the tests.
tekst-resonnement: Anna buys 23 pens at 12 kr each, and every 5th pen is free. The number of free pens is 23/5 rounded down, which is 4, so she pays for 19 pens: 19 × 12 = 228 kr.
tekst-forskning: According to 2 independent studies from 2023, regular exercise cuts depression risk by about 25%. A 3rd study found no effect, but it had only 80 participants. So the effect is likely real and moderate. I read only the abstracts. Before citing, check whether the studies controlled for income.
tekst-kodegjennomgang: I reviewed the PR. The file src/payments/checkout_service.py (C) calls validate_card() (F) from src/payments/validators.py. F accepted expired cards, so I added a check to F and a test in tests/test_validators.py; all tests there pass. C logs the full card number, which is a security risk; I did not change it because it is out of scope.
